root: ^What the hell just happened back there? Dominic is dead? This was supposed to be my big break too. Shit, shit, shit!

s: ^Where were you when the murder happened?
^In the last scene of the play, you seemed to have a prop gun, could it have been loaded?
^Your clothing seems torn up, any reason that happened?

c-0: ^Well, me and Dominic were just wrapping up our scene, and we were about to move onto the next one. It was only us on stage right before the murder. I went back to go take a drink, and then suddenly the lights went out. Then the light got fixed and I saw my co-star dead, on the ground! That’s all I know, honest!
c-1: ^Well, it's a prop gun. It couldn’t be used to kill or threaten someone. It's loaded with blanks. I’m no detective, but if someone was in a rush to kill someone, usually they leave their weapon on the crime scene in a rush.
c-2: ^Well, it must’ve been from the rush from seeing the body. The attacker could have been anywhere, I had to get out of there! However, I do recall seeing that lady in dark blue get her dress torn up. Maybe she left something out on the stage?
c-3: ^Hurry, we gotta find whoever did this!
